"[[I've Lost Artoo!]]" is a pretty good card for an Imperial space deck. Since your "[[Executor]]" has only 2 hyperspeed and your "Star Destroyers" have only 3 you may have trouble getting "[[Red 5]]" or other fast starships so you play "[[I've Lost Artoo!]]" All you have to do is get a destiny over one and its hyperspeed is reduced to zero. Now you take two turns to catch up with them and you with two or three "Star Destroyers" completely overpower them. It can also stop "[[Kessel (Dark){{!}}Kessel]] Runs."

A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc in the bottom-right corner of the card frame, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 6 August 2016. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-ivelostartoo-PC-Errata-2016-disc-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[I've Lost Artoo! (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): The game text is reworded: “Use 1 Force to target a starship’s [nav computer] or astromech. Draw destiny. If destiny &gt; 1, [nav computer] or astromech is lost. If starship’s [nav computer] icon is lost, place Effect on starship (may add 1 astromech); otherwise, Effect lost.” This is a full card image with the printed art, lore and title. There is no title strip and no “E”; a small round bronze disc sits in the bottom-right corner of the card frame.

The 2013 slip and the same area of the disc card image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
